articles.desc: Cremona: Ein Tornado hat eine der markantesten mittelalterlichen Kirchen Norditaliens schwer beschädigt: die Kathedrale von Cremona. Durch das Unwetter gestern brach der obere Teil eines Turms ab und zerschellte auf dem Vorplatz, wie Bilder im italienischen Fernsehen zeigten. articles.title: Parental care can influence evolution, beetle experiments show
articles.desc: How has offspring dependence on parents evolved over the course of evolution? Researchers at the University of Bayreuth, in collaboration with Kyoto University, Japan, have investigated one possible mechanism by studying the burying beetle Nicrophorus vespilloides. Their new study shows that parents do more than simply provide care for their offspring: They also improve the entire developmental environment in which their young grow up, a factor that may itself have influenced evolutionary change. The findings have been published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

articles.title: One molecule, one photon: Entanglement makes an imperceptible recoil measurable
